senses.gloss: (cmp. נָטַע) to stretch; to pitch a tent.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 67:1">Yalk. Gen. 67</cite> <he>בתחלה נ׳ אהלה וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:15">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>נטע</he>) first he pitched Sarah’s tent &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:7">Macc. II, 7</cite> <he>ונופו נוֹטֶה</he>, v. <cite ref="N00390"><he>נוֹף</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 40b">Kidd. 40ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 4:5">Ned. IV, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>הנוֹטוֹת</he> overhanging fruit.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:1:16">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ</cite> <he>בנוֹטוֹת</he> when one’s mustache hangs over the mouth.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6b:12">Snh. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>להיכן הדין נוטה</he> which way the judgment will incline (in whose favor the verdict will be).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 3b:6">Ib. 3ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:2">Ex. XXIII, 2</cite>) <he>עשה לך בית דין נוטה</he> arrange for thyself a court which can lean towards one side, i.e. of uneven numbers.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96">Gen. R. s. 96</cite>, a. fr. <he>נ׳ למות</he> one inclines towards dying, feels death approaching; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to bend, pervert judgment. Mekh. Mishp. s. 20 שמא תאמר … ואיני נוטה את הדין lest you say, I will take a bribe but will not pervert the law.—Part. pass. נָטוּי; f. נְטוּיָה; pl. נְטוּיִים, נְטוּיִין; נְטוּיוֹת

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a:13">Snh. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>קיר נ׳</he> a threatening wall; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:5">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>נ׳ למות</he>, v. supra.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: spread; pitched. Ohol. VII, 2. Tosef. ib. VIII, 2; a. e.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:3">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>הִיטּוּ כותלי וכ׳</he> the walls of the school-house bowed (threatening to fall).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ועדיין מַטִּין ועומדין</he> and so they still stand bending over.
<cite ref="Berakhot 11a:15">Ber. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>הִטֵּתִי</he>, v. <cite ref="G00649"><he>זָקַף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 84b">Keth. 84ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 46b:7">Erub. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>מַטִּין</he> one is inclined (in favor of R. Akiba’s opinion), i.e. the presumption is in his favor, opp. <cite ref="E00566"><he>הלכה</he></cite> definite decision for general practice. Y. Snh. I, 18ᵃ bot. (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 22:19">I Kings XXII, 19</cite>) <he>אלו מטין לכף זכות וכ׳</he> these argued in favor, and those against.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:2">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ורב חסד מַטֶּה וכ׳</he> and He who is abundant in kindness inclines (the scales) towards the side of kindness; a. fr.

Keth. 10ᵃ a man walking in the dark, ה׳ מצאו פתוח if he moves sideways (towards the door), he finds it open, if he does not (but strikes against the door) &c.—Trnsf. to perform coition without violently tearing the hymen.
<cite ref="Ketubot 10a">Ib.</cite>

senses.gloss: (act. verb) to bend; ה׳ דין to wrest judgment. Mekh. l. c. שלא תאמר … אַטֶּה עליו את הדין say not, because he is a wicked man, I will turn the verdict against him.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:9">Peah VIII, 9</cite> <he>כל דיין … ומַטֶּה את הדין</he> a judge that takes a bribe and perverts judgment; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (after Ex. XXIII, 2) to decide by majority (cmp. כָּרַע).
units: Snh. IV, 1 דיני ממונות מטין וכ׳ in civil law a majority of one decides in favor or against (the claimant), ודיני נפשות מטין וכ׳ in criminal law a majority of one decides in favor of the defendant, but for a verdict against the defendant a majority of two is required, v. הַטָּיָה. Mekh. l. c. הרוג על פי מטין put to death on a majority vote; מה עדים … אף מטין בשנים as incriminating witnessess must be two, so must the majority be two.—Part. pass. מוּטֶּה; f. מוּטָּה reclining, bending over.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 21a">M. Kat. 21ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 103a:1">Yeb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>בין עומד … בין מ׳</he> standing, sitting or reclining.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 4:3">Kel. IV, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 10</cite> <he>היתה מ׳ על צדה וכ׳</he> if the vessel was misshaped so as to bend sideways like a sedan chair.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:10">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:5">ib. 5</cite> <he>מַטָּה על צדה</he>.—V. <cite ref="M00463"><he>מוּטָּה</he></cite>.
